Want to skip the gym and get paid to work out? Come work at Søstrene Grene as a Furniture Logistics Associate!
You’ll be working with our popular home items, like chairs, tables, and cozy furniture, for both stores and online customers. Yes, it's active work with items up to 20 kg, but you don't have to do it alone! Our EPTs and Reachtrucks will help you with the heavy lifting. With easy digital scanners to track the stock, you'll work in a comfortable 2-shift rotation and earn up to €19.80 per hour. Ready to stay fit and work in a friendly team? Join us!

What we offer
- Top pay up to €19.80 per hour!
- Higher salary based on your experience
- Tasty lunch options on early shifts
- Free breakfast every Tuesday & Thursday
- Get paid during your short breaks
- No heavy uniform—wear your own comfy clothes!

Who you are
As our Furniture Logistics Associate, it is important that you meet the following requirements:

- You can work in a 2 shift system ( 7.00-15.00 / 15.00 - 23.00 )
- You have your own transport to work in Sevenum/Venlo
- You are full time available
- You understand and speak English

What will you do
Your main focus is getting our stunning furniture collection—from chic tables to cozy chairs—ready for stores and online customers. You’ll double-check orders, scan stock effortlessly, and build solid pallets. Don't worry about doing all the heavy lifting (items up to 20 kg) by hand; you’ll operate EPTs and Reachtrucks to clear the heavy work with ease. It's an active, satisfying role where you stay on the move, master cool machinery, and see our top Scandinavian designs pass through your hands every day!

Where will you work
Welcome to a spacious, bright warehouse where Scandinavian design meets a great team spirit! At Søstrene Grene, you’ll join a supportive crew working in a comfortable 2-shift rotation. Even though you’re handling our heavier furniture items, you’ll have all the right tools—like EPTs and Reachtrucks—to make the job smooth and manageable

jobs.description:
Are you a morning person who also enjoys sleeping in sometimes? Or do you like having that kind of variety? Then we have the perfect job for you at Arvato in Heijen as a warehouse employee!
You’ll work in a comfortable 2-shift system, earning €14.99 per hour. And because we know evening work takes extra energy, you’ll get a 19% shift allowance on top of that after 7 PM. That's €17,84! And the best part? You get paid every week, so you always have your money in hand quickly!

What we offer
- A salary of €14,99
- €17,84 after 7:00 PM
- Ready to start immediately? No problem!
- Travel allowance & holiday pay
- Get paid weekly
- Working with major brands

Who you are
As a warehouse worker, it’s important that you meet the following requirements:

- You speak English
- You are available immediately
- You can work at least 4 days a week
- You are able to work in a 2-shift system
- You have your own transport to work in Heijen

What will you do
At Arvato in Heijen, you’ll work with great brands. You’ll make sure everything in logistics runs smoothly. This means processing incoming packages, picking and packing orders, preparing shipments, and managing inventory. You’ll use modern systems and pitch in wherever hands-on help is needed

Where will you work
You’ll join an energetic team where teamwork and a good atmosphere are key. The variety in your work and the flexible schedule make the job even more enjoyable. Plus, with the 35% shift allowance, you earn extra when working evenings. And since we pay you every week, you won’t have to wait long to get your hard-earned money. Our modern workplace is the perfect place for you to enjoy your work.

Job application
Good to know: within 15 minutes after you apply, you’ll receive a WhatsApp message from us. We’ll ask you a few short questions about your application to help you faster. Don’t have WhatsApp? No worries! We’ll get in touch by phone or email.  Uiteraard staat deze vacature open voor iedereen die zich hierin herkent.

As a warehouse worker at DHL eCommerce in ‘s-Hertogenbosch, you work part-time, between 15 and 35 hours per week. You work in the evening (5:00 PM - 12:00 AM) or night (2:00 AM - 8:00 AM). The job is physically demanding, but you get a good salary in return. You sort parcels on the conveyor belt and help keep the logistics process running smoothly.
Your day starts with a short briefing. Then, the sorting process begins. Together with your colleagues, you make sure every parcel ends up in the right place. The work is repetitive, but you stay active throughout your shift. There is time for a short break. Since the job can be physically demanding, it’s important that you are fit.
This role suits you if you like to stay active and are ready for something new. No experience is required; we’ll teach you everything. Excited? Apply now and start your new job soon! 🚀

- Minimum pre-vocational (vmbo) working and thinking level

- You are at least 18 years old

- No experience required; s​tarters are welcome

- You speak Dutch or English

- You have your own transport because of the working hours

- You live within 30 km of ‘s-Hertogenbosch

- You are able to do physically demanding work
